item.title: Exercise Session Leader
item.description:
Mathematics Exercise Leader — Discrete Mathematics & Algorithms

Personally recommended by the course lecturer to the Head of the Mathematics Department and selected as 1 of only 3 students trusted to lead weekly exercise sessions for first-year students.

Co-designing the exercise curriculum from scratch, pacing it to the lectures and shaping it around student feedback to give first-years the best possible route into the subject.

item.title: Cashier
item.description:
Cashier — Lee Baguette

Assisted customers with menu selections and special requests. Processed transactions accurately and efficiently while maintaining a clean, organised checkout area.

Kept service fast and reliable through the busy weekday lunch rush and peak summer tourist season, when customers needed to be served quickly to get back to work on time.

item.title: Preschool Teacher
item.description:
Preschool Teacher — Rödeby Förskola Tallbacken, Sweden (Sep 2022 – Aug 2024)

Designed engaging lesson plans tailored to diverse learning styles and developmental needs. Facilitated daily classroom activities to build social skills and cooperation among children. Collaborated with parents on child progress and supported fellow teachers with planning and classroom management.

Trusted with responsibilities beyond the role’s scope: writing classroom activity reports for the bulletin board and sending weekly newsletters and important updates to parents.

item.title: Vietnam Maritime Commercial Joint Stock Bank
item.description:
Vietnam Maritime Commercial Joint Stock Bank — 8 Years (2011–2019)

Operations Process Officer · Sep 2017 – Oct 2019

Selected as 1 of 2 officers to lead process design for a bank-wide transformation migrating the entire customer service division from operations to specialised retail banking — owned procedure writing, staff training, department-wide newsletters, cross-department procedure reviews, and overtime-policy negotiations with HR.

Chosen as 1 of 3 department representatives on the bank’s core-system migration project, responsible for the payment account and savings account modules.

item.title: General Accountant
item.description:
General Accountant — 19.8 Trading & Services Co., Ltd.

Managed accounts payable/receivable and prepared monthly financial statements. Reconciled bank statements and performed month-end closing procedures.
